text:
incident-bot: Pager — RESV-GPU-CRITICAL: reserved pool eu-west-2-resv-42 at 100% GPU utilization, queue length 1,920 requests, avg queue latency 18s. Paging @devon_oncall and @maria_sre :rotating_light:

devon_oncall: Acked. I'm looking now. Is this affecting enterprise tenants only or shared pool?

maria_sre: It's the reserved pool for enterprise reservations — AcmeCorp and NovaHealth both on the same pool. Metric spike started ~5m ago. Noisy neighbor suspected (bursty unbounded jobs from t-944).

kevin_runtime: Checking autoscaler logs, getting repeated errors: `scale_up failed: quota_exceeded region eu-west-2 GPUs requested=8 available_quota=0`

kevin_runtime: Paste from autoscaler: ```2025-09-12T03:35:12Z ERROR autoscaler.go:145 scaleUp: quota_exceeded: projectQuota=200 used=200 request=8```

sam_platform: Confirmed cloud quota for eu-west-2 is at cap. We can't spin new reserved nodes. AWS account-level GPU limit hit.

devon_oncall: That explains autoscale failure. Immediate mitigation suggestions?

sam_platform: Options: 1) throttle non-enterprise (best-effort) traffic away from this reserved pool and force routed traffic to hosted fallback; 2) drain/evict noisy tenant workloads (requires tenant-level ops); 3) request emergency quota increase from cloud (slow).

priya_csm: We should notify AcmeCorp and NovaHealth ASAP — they may see increased latency/fails. I'll draft a short message.

devon_oncall: Prioritize preserving enterprise SLA. Step 1: apply temporary route rule to reduce best-effort tenant access to eu-west-2-resv-42 by 90% and route to hosted fallback region/us-hosted-1. Sam, can you push that route?

sam_platform: On it. Pushing routing change now: `routectl update --pool eu-west-2-resv-42 --block-tag=best-effort --percent=90 --fallback=us-hosted-1`

deploy-bot: runbook action started by sam_platform: routectl update (change id r-2054001111-01), status: in_progress

kevin_runtime: Also found KV cache pressure — some long-running chat sessions holding token cache that prevent GC. We'll mark sessions >6h as low priority to free KV slots. Command: `sessionctl set-priority --age 6h --priority low`

devon_oncall: Execute that too, Kevin. Also list top 3 tenants by GPU consumption so we know noisy neighbor.

kevin_runtime: Top consumers in pool: t-944 (noisy-burst-engine) 44% of pool, t-1132 (acme-enterprise) 21%, t-2201 (novahealth) 19%. Rest 16% shared.

maria_sre: Since autoscale can't add nodes, we need to evict or throttle t-944. Policy allows eviction of non-reserved burst jobs within reserved pools if they exceed burst quota. Devon, do you want me to trigger eviction?

devon_oncall: Yes. Evict non-pinned jobs for t-944 and mark tenant as throttled. Priya — prepping customer comms for Acme & NovaHealth (heads up + apology).

sam_platform: Running eviction: `opsctl evict-jobs --tenant t-944 --pool eu-west-2-resv-42 --criteria 'priority<=low OR runtime>30m' --dry-run=false`

deploy-bot: opsctl evict-jobs started by sam_platform (job id ev-2054001111-02), status: success, evicted 38 tasks, recovered 6% GPU capacity

devon_oncall: Good. Re-check queue length.

kevin_runtime: Queue now 1,520 requests, avg latency 14s. Token throughput down 12%. We freed some headroom but still above target.

sam_platform: Applied routing throttle for best-effort. Fallback acceptance rate to hosted is 500rps. We should see queue shrink more in next 3–5m.

priya_csm: AcmeCorp notified via support ticket #INC-4382 and direct Slack DM to their platform lead. Message: "We're actively mitigating a capacity issue in eu-west-2 affecting reserved pools. We're prioritizing your traffic and expect improvements in <30m. Apologies for the disruption"

maria_sre: Creating incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2054001111 (doc created). Tagging for postmortem and quota follow-up with cloud infra.

devon_oncall: If queue doesn't return to SLO in 25m, escalate to platform lead and open cloud emergency quota request. Maria, can you take primary for postmortem?

maria_sre: Will own postmortem. I've scheduled a 30m follow-up call. Also starting a ticket to track quota increase with infra@cloudops.

kevin_runtime: Observability note: error spike in `model-infer`: 5xx increased from 0.2% to 3.6% during peak. Correlates with queue latency. Recording these metrics in incident doc.

devon_oncall: Thanks team. Handoff to platform for longer-term work. I'll keep monitoring for 15m then hand to maria for deeper triage. If anyone sees >50% queue reduction, update here.

sam_platform: FYI — opened cloud support: case CS-99822 requesting temporary quota bump + reasoning. ETA unknown.

priya_csm: I'll send a short customer note once we hit 30% reduction to confirm service recovery.

maria_sre: Handoff accepted. Devon -> maria at 2054001399. I'll keep this thread updated and post a short timeline once we close. :white_check_mark:
